title: 17 September 2017: Paul McCartney live at Madison Square Garden, New York City
content:
Paul McCartney performed at Madison Square Garden in New York City, USA, on 17 September 2017.

It was the 58th show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between April 2016 and December 2017, and the second of two nights at MSG.

Night 2 #MSG #OneOnOne pic.twitter.com/TxKZkGbPGB

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) September 17, 2017

A sold-out @TheGarden just #OneOnOne tonight with @PaulMcCartney! pic.twitter.com/GT4Acu3Ahy

— MSG (@TheGarden) September 18, 2017

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at Madison Square Garden with Wings on 24 and 25 May 1976, and during the Paul McCartney World Tour on 11, 12, 14, and 15 December 1989.

He returned there for The Concert For New York City on 20 October 2001; the Driving World Tour on 26 and 27 April 2002; the US Tour on 30 September, 1, 4, and 5 October 2005; and the Concert For Sandy Relief on 12 December 2012.

Thank you @PaulMcCartney for two wonderful nights at @TheGarden. Until next time, “shine on until tomorrow, let it be.” #OneOnOne pic.twitter.com/67EB3uo24z

— MSG (@TheGarden) September 18, 2017
